verdict.rationale: Docs show regional capability exists — you can list available regions for a database and configured Vitess read-only regions on a branch — and separate replica docs describe read replicas for reducing primary load, implying geographic replica placement is supported. However, there is no first-party or hands-on documentation walking through configuring multi-region replicas for latency reduction, and no independent corroboration of global latency benefits. Missing for 10: dedicated docs/tutorial on placing replicas in specific regions for user-proximity latency, and community/hands-on evidence confirming reduced worldwide read latency.
